definitions.meaning: A meeting intended to cause trouble or molestation, an attack upon an enemy

quotations.english: if he could bring about a meeting with his foe

source_text: torn-gemót, es; n. A meeting intended to cause trouble or molestation, an attack upon an enemy:--Gif hé torngemót þurhteón mihte if he could bring about a meeting with his foe, Beo. Th. 2284; B. 1140.
